S498.en: Just then, a truck goes by, honking away at Lexie.

S503.text: 렉시 아들을 웃게 한 축구 코치 어니.
S503.en: Ernie, the soccer coach who got Lexie's son laughing.

S505.text: 노블리는 이날 동네 야구팀 단체 사진을 찍는데요.
S505.en: That day, Novalee is shooting a team photo of the local ball team.

S510.text: 다들 포니가 이참에 동네를 뜰 거라는데,
S510.en: Everyone figures Forney will take this chance to leave town,

S513.text: 그날 밤 걸려 온 전화 한 통.

S517.en: The moment she hangs up, she rushes over.

S519.en: The two of them hug warmly.

S527.text: 사서 자리는 벌써 시장 딸 차지.
S527.en: The librarian job has already gone to the mayor's daughter,

S535.en: He demands to know if it was just pity, then.

S537.en: She dodges, calling him the best friend she's ever had,

S540.text: 얼어붙은 포니를 두고, 노블리는 도망치듯 떠나 버립니다.
S540.en: Leaving Forney frozen, Novalee leaves as if running away.

S541.en: A man who can only watch from the window. Is this the end for them?

S542.text: 석 달 뒤, 렉시와 노블리가 둘러보는 빈집.
S542.en: Three months later, Lexie and Novalee look around an empty house.

S545.en: Every letter to her daughter carries one line of regards for her mother.

S547.en: Lexie tells her to write that it was a lie and ask him to come back,

S549.text: 돌아와 봤자 공장 아니면 햄버거 가게라는 한숨.
S549.en: A sigh: if he came back, it would only be the factory or a burger stand.

S554.en: For all her shrugging, she ends up marrying Ernie.

S556.text: 피로연에서 렉시는, 어니를 고른 진짜 이유를 털어놓는데요.
S556.en: At the reception, Lexie confides the real reason she picked Ernie.

S558.en: He has raised another man's daughter as his own.

S563.text: 다들 짝과 춤추는 사이, 홀로 테이블을 지키는 쓸쓸한 얼굴.
S563.en: While everyone dances with a partner, a lonely face sits alone at the table.

S564.text: 한편 윌리 잭은 루스의 차로 밤길을 달리는데요.
S564.en: Meanwhile, Willy Jack is riding down a night road in Ruth's car.

S566.text: 약과 술 말고 뭐라도 좀 먹으라며, 루스 혼자 차에서 내립니다.
S566.en: Telling him to eat something besides pills and whiskey, Ruth gets out of the car alone.

S567.text: 덩그러니 남은 윌리 잭, 술병을 든 채 비틀비틀 기찻길로 향하는 발걸음.
S567.en: Left all alone, Willy Jack staggers toward the railroad tracks, bottle in hand.

S569.text: 그때 귓가를 맴도는, 5년 전 노블리의 목소리.
S569.en: Then Novalee's voice from five years ago rings in his ears.

S573.text: 그날 아기 심장 소리를 외면했던 남자, 그가 쓰러진 곳은 선로 위.
S573.en: The man who ignored the baby's heartbeat that day collapses right on the rails.

S574.text: 과연 달려오는 기차를 피할 수 있을까요?
S574.en: Can he get clear of the oncoming train?

S575.text: 넉 달 뒤, 아메리쿠스의 다섯 살 생일.
S575.en: Four months later, Americus's fifth birthday.

S579.text: 5자만 붙으면 탈이 났으니, 다섯 살 생일은 경계 대상 1호.
S579.en: Anything with a five has meant trouble, so the fifth birthday is public enemy number one.

S582.text: 신문에 실린 건 다름 아닌 윌리 잭 소식.
S582.en: The story in the paper is about none other than Willy Jack.

S584.text: 기차 사고로 두 다리를 잃고, 하필 휴게소 화장실에 갇혔다는데요.
S584.en: He lost both legs in a train accident and, of all places, got stuck in a rest-stop restroom.

S585.text: 노블리는 그 길로 윌리 잭의 병실을 찾아갑니다.
S585.en: Novalee goes straight to Willy Jack's hospital room.

S595.en: A nurse comes running, drawn by shouting that carried down the hall.

S597.text: 잘나가던 가수에서 두 다리 잃은 환자 신세.
S597.en: From a hit singer to a patient who has lost both legs.

S604.text: 거짓말 하나가 인생을 통째로 바꿔 놓는다며, 눈시울을 붉히는데,
S604.en: Saying a single lie can change your whole life, his eyes fill with tears,

S608.text: 그리고 노블리는 차를 몰아 먼 길에 오릅니다.
S608.en: And Novalee sets off on a long drive.

S609.text: 포니가 다니는 메인 주의 대학, 이번엔 노블리가 거짓말을 바로잡을 차례.
S609.en: Forney's college in Maine. Now it's her turn to set a lie straight.

S610.text: 아무리 찾아도 보이지 않아 벤치에 털썩, 이대로 엇갈리고 마는 걸까요?
S610.en: She can't find him anywhere and slumps onto a bench. Will they miss each other after all?

S611.text: 그러던 그때, 계단 위 학생들 사이로 포니가 보이는데요.
S611.en: Just then, she spots Forney among the students on the steps.

S612.text: 그런데 곁엔 다정해 보이는 여학생, 그대로 굳어 버리는 표정.
S612.en: But next to him is a friendly-looking female student, and her face freezes.

S618.en: She had driven Willy Jack back home.

S620.text: 그때 불쑥, 커피를 마시러 가자며 여학생이 끼어드는데,
S620.en: Then a female student cuts in, asking him to come for coffee,

S628.text: 5년을 돌고 돌아, 드디어 서로에게 닿은 마음.
S628.en: After five years of going around in circles, their hearts finally meet.

S629.text: 결혼식은 무려 월마트에서, 반가운 얼굴들이 하객으로 모입니다.
S629.en: Their wedding takes place at, of all places, Walmart, with familiar faces gathered as guests.

S630.text: 바퀴 달린 집만 아니면 좋다던 그 소녀에게, 마침내 진짜 집과 가족이 생긴 거죠.
S630.en: The girl who wanted any home without wheels finally has a real home and a family.

S632.en: That was Where the Heart Is, from 2000.

S633.text: 빌리 레츠의 베스트셀러 소설을 원작으로, 매트 윌리엄스 감독이 연출을 맡았습니다.
S633.en: Based on Billie Letts's best-selling novel, it was directed by Matt Williams.

S634.text: 모든 걸 잃은 열일곱 소녀가, 낯선 동네 사람들 품에서 새 가족을 찾아가는 이야기.
S634.en: The story of a seventeen-year-old girl who lost everything and finds a new family among the people of a strange town.

S635.text: 제목 그대로, 집은 건물이 아니라 마음이 머무는 곳이라는 걸 따뜻하게 보여 주는 영화입니다.
S635.en: True to its title, it is a film that warmly shows that home is not a building but where the heart is.

S636.text: 당시 열여덟 살이던 나탈리 포트만, 그리고 애슐리 주드의 열연도 꼭 눈여겨보세요.
S636.en: Be sure to watch the fine performances of Natalie Portman, eighteen at the time, and Ashley Judd.

S637.text: 아직 못 보셨다면, 처음부터 끝까지 꼭 한번 보시길 추천드립니다.
S637.en: If you haven't seen it yet, I highly recommend watching it from beginning to end.

S638.text: 오늘 영상 재미있게 보셨다면, 좋아요와 구독, 알림 설정도 부탁드립니다.
S638.en: If you enjoyed today's video, please like, subscribe, and turn on notifications.
